title: MIN and MAX of a date column, ignoring BLANK
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "min", MIN ( V[Dt] ), "max", MAX ( V[Dt] ) )

source.quote: This formula therefore returns the date that is earliest.
source.supports: MIN of a date column is the earliest date

source.quote: The result is blank in case there are no rows in the table with a non-blank value.
source.supports: blank only when no row has a value: blanks are otherwise ignored
